name: Shemaiah
title: Prophet in Judah
summary: Shemaiah was a man of God and a prophet who served during the reign of King Rehoboam in Judah. He is best known for preventing a civil war between the northern and southern tribes by delivering God's word that the division of the kingdom was according to God's will. He also delivered God's message when Pharaoh Shishak threatened Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Warned Against Civil War
keyEvents.description: Shemaiah received a word from God and warned King Rehoboam and all Judah and Benjamin not to go to war against Israel. The people obeyed the Lord's word and returned home.

keyEvents.title: The Division of the Kingdom Explained as God's Will
keyEvents.description: Shemaiah conveyed that the split of the united kingdom was from the Lord, and that the tribes should not fight against their brothers.

keyEvents.title: Prophetic Message During Shishak's Invasion
keyEvents.description: When Pharaoh Shishak of Egypt attacked Judah, Shemaiah came to Rehoboam and the leaders with a message that the Lord had abandoned them because they had abandoned Him.

keyEvents.title: The People's Humility and God's Grace
keyEvents.description: When Rehoboam and the leaders humbled themselves after Shemaiah's prophetic words, the Lord said he would not destroy them completely but grant them some deliverance.

keyEvents.title: Chronicler and Historian
keyEvents.description: Shemaiah is mentioned as one who recorded the history and deeds of King Rehoboam, together with the seer Iddo.
